attributes.check: P10/P07 retry after the prior GUI inference was corrected. launchd confirmed an Aqua login session and SystemUIServer, so no claim is made about the user Mac lacking a display. The zero NSScreen count was from a standalone Swift agent-shell process only. The current isolated native baseline app was tried via LaunchServices from both /private/tmp and its /tmp standardized alias; both failed before the App wrote a baseline result, returning NSOSStatusErrorDomain -10827 kLSNoExecutableErr. Its Info.plist names AgentDeck; the executable exists and is 0755; ad-hoc signing did not change the LaunchServices failure. Two private DerivedData Xcode builds (parallel and serial macOS-only) failed with status 65 because ObservationIgnoredMacro could not be loaded and swift-plugin-server returned a malformed response. `pgrep`/`ps` are denied by this agent runtime. Existing usage source_commit profile counts calls and records total/max, but does not retain per-transaction samples for p95. No native frame or P10 sample was produced; no P07 aggregate process/RSS or transaction p95/max was produced. All data is synthetic/private; no installed App or user database was used. Exact resume prerequisites: a native execution channel where LaunchServices can run the current candidate App and capture its painted popover, a functioning Xcode macro plugin build, and process aggregate plus individual write-transaction timing capture. These are runner/measurement blockers, not a product performance outcome.
attributes.producer: Codex native-harness retry and capability review
